remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(streamci.dll streamci.spec)

# streamci.dll is all Rust (streamci-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/streamci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# streamci.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/streamci-rust/src/streamci/streamci.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(streamci_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(streamci_shims PRIVATE uuid wine librpcrt4 libsetupapi libadvapi32 libiphlpapi libdhcpcsvc libole32 libuser32 libcomctl32 libws2_32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_cargo_module(streamci streamci-cargo streamci.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE streamci-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS streamci_shims psdk uuid_sources)
